descriptions: This fighter holds the record for being the very first person onscreen to cut off a Saiyan's tail.
They started their career as a desert bandit who was terrified of women.
They are famously mocked by fans for their iconic 'dead in a crater' pose.
They control a unique physical ki slicing attack called the Spirit Ball.
The scarred martial artist whose constant companion is a floating blue cat.
In the original manga, this character is the only Z-Fighter who never speaks a single word to Piccolo.
They have a bizarre birth defect where they completely lack a nose.
They have tragically died more times than almost any other Earthling warrior.
They surprised everyone by marrying Android 18 in the Majin Buu saga.
Goku's bald best friend who uses the signature Destructo Disc attack.
This character is the only person to ever successfully land a bite on Frieza, Majin Buu, and Beerus in battle.
This warrior surprisingly possesses a legitimate driver's license on Earth.
They refuse to use standard Godly Ki but reached a massive form called 'Beast'.
They famously defeated Cell after unlocking Super Saiyan 2 as a kid.
Goku's oldest son who was primarily raised and trained by Piccolo.
Akira Toriyama revealed in an interview that this character's favorite food is actually water.
They shed their evil identity by bonding with a young boy named Gohan.
They routinely regenerate missing limbs during brutal physical fights.
They permanently fused bodies with both Nail and Kami to gain power.
The stoic, green-skinned warrior who serves as the tactical brains of the team.
This character is legally a princess due to her father's massive fiery kingdom.
She met her future husband when she accidentally kicked him off a flying cloud.
She famously terrifies the strongest universe-destroying warriors with her temper.
She prioritizes her children's academic studies over saving the Earth.
Goku's fiercely protective wife and the daughter of the Ox-King.
This character is heavily implied to be the main reason Tien never got a girlfriend, as she chased him away.
They have a bizarre biological condition where they sneeze to swap personalities.
Their hair dramatically changes from dark blue to bright blonde when triggered.
They completely disappeared from the main storyline for the entirety of Dragon Ball Z.
The dual-personality girl who regularly carries submachine guns.
This character single-handedly slapped the God of Destruction, Beerus, across the face for ruining her party.
They are a brilliant mechanical prodigy who built a functioning radar at age sixteen.
They routinely use the Dragon Balls purely for cosmetic plastic surgery adjustments.
She is the wealthy heiress of the multi-billion-dollar Capsule Corporation.
The blue-haired tech genius who has been Goku's companion since day one.
According to Daizenshuu guides, this warrior belongs to a rare clan of Earthlings descended from aliens.
They possess a rare physical trait consisting of three fully functional eyes.
They successfully pinned down Semi-Perfect Cell using a spam of Tri-Beam blasts.
They maintain a lifelong, inseparable brotherly bond with a small floating mime.
The tall, disciplined Z-Fighter who famously trains on waterfalls with Chiaotzu.
They maintain their extreme lifespan by eating a magical item called the Paradise Herb.
They spent 50 years mastering a technique that Goku learned in less than a minute.
They entered the World Tournament under the secret alias 'Jackie Chun'.
They carry a massive turtle shell on their back and love adult magazines.
Goku's perverted, elderly first martial arts teacher.
This entity exists as a primordial magical being that has actually been alive since time immemorial.
They can instantly convert their enemies into chocolate, candy, or cookies.
They possess a hyper-regenerative physical body that acts like pink chewing gum.
They became best friends with Mr. Satan after adopting a stray puppy.
The chubby, child-like pink entity who loves eating sweets.
This character is the only mortal across all universes to win an entire multiversal tournament alone.
This character is actually a mechanical cyborg originally born human as 'Lapis'.
They initially died when their internal emergency bomb switch was activated.
They work as a dedicated wildlife park ranger protecting an island of Minotaurs.
The cool, scarf-wearing twin brother of Android 18.
This character is the only Saiyan hybrid to achieve a form called Super Saiyan Rage.
They are a time-traveling warrior who arrived in a Capsule Corp time machine.
They sliced Mecha-Frieza into tiny pieces using a signature broadsword.
They grew up in a dark, apocalyptic future ruined by cruel androids.
The lavender-haired son of Vegeta who traveled back to save the past.
This character managed to achieve a massive power boost by training for the first time ever in their life.
They belong to an elite, horned alien race known as the Frost Demons.
They survived being cut in half and caught in Planet Namek's explosion.
They achieved forms called 'Mecha', 'Golden', and recently 'Black'.
The ruthless galactic tyrant responsible for wiping out the Saiyan race.
This character fused permanently with a witch centuries ago, which drastically altered their appearance and powers.
This entity is millions of years old but spent centuries trapped inside the Z Sword.
They unlocked Gohan’s latent potential through a bizarre, hours-long dancing ritual.
They gave up their own life force so Goku could return to Earth and fight Buu.
The wrinkly, eccentric deity who leads the higher ranks of the universe.
This character once safely absorbed and ingested an entire blast from Super Saiyan Goku without taking damage.
They live in a massive, floating palace located directly above Korin's Tower.
They are an immortal, djinn-like entity who serves as the attendant to Kami.
They meticulously tend to the palace gardens and look after the Dragon Balls.
The turban-wearing, pitch-black character who serves the Guardian of Earth.
This character wears a rare potara earring on the opposite ear of a typical Supreme Kai.
They are the direct genetic clone of Goku created from an alternate timeline.
They despise mortals and launched a systematic slaughter called the 'Zero Mortals Plan'.
They utilize a signature purple ki blade that manifests directly from their hand.
The rogue Supreme Kai apprentice Zamasu who stole Goku's physical body.
This entity's character design was directly inspired by Akira Toriyama's old, hairless Cornish Rex cat.
They are a purple alien deity who absolutely loves gourmet Earth food.
They spent thousands of years asleep until dreaming of a Super Saiyan God.
They can instantly erase targets out of physical existence using the word 'Hakai'.
The temperamental God of Destruction belonging to Universe 7.
This master martial artist has lived on Earth for over 3000 years in complete isolation.
They are a giant, magical talking cat who resides atop a massive tower.
They are the exclusive grower of the life-saving, stamina-restoring Senzu Beans.
They trained a young Goku by making him chase them to retrieve Holy Water.
The white, sword-carrying martial arts master cat who lives in the clouds.
This warrior's supreme power is completely derived from absolute, unyielding emotional trauma from their childhood.
They are a massive, muscular alien warrior who belongs to the Pride Troopers.
They meditate constantly in battle to keep their overwhelming power stable.
They fought Goku's Mastered Ultra Instinct in the finale of the Tournament of Power.
The gray, alien-looking ultimate powerhouse champion of Universe 11.
When translated literally from Hanzi/Kanji, this character's name means 'God Dragon'.
This entity is a massive, eternal dragon summoned using seven glowing artifacts.
They were temporarily killed when King Piccolo physically blasted them to dust.
They grant wishes but will immediately turn to stone and scatter if completed.
The legendary green Dragon of Earth who famously grants three wishes.
